shortDescription: Consolidate fragmented files on local volumes

options.name: exclude_volumes
options.description: A list of drive letters or mount point paths to exclude from defragmentation.

options.name: freespace_consolidation
options.description: Perform free space consolidation on the specified volumes.

options.name: include_volumes
options.description: A list of drive letters or mount point paths of the volumes to be defragmented. If this parameter is omitted, all volumes (not excluded) will be fragmented.

options.name: parallel
options.description: Run the operation on each volume in parallel in the background.

options.name: priority
options.description: Run the operation at low or normal priority.
